title: NavigationModel
description: Create AggregatorApp/iPad/NavigationModel.swift with two types: (1) AppSection enum with cases .threads, .sources, .today, .podcasts, .search, .settings; (2) iPadNavigationModel (@Observable final class) with properties: selectedSection: AppSection = .threads, selectedThread: Thread?, selectedArticle: Article?, selectedSource: Source?, selectedEpisode: Episode?. Also update AggregatorApp/AggregatorApp.swift to instantiate iPadNavigationModel and inject it as an @Environment object at the app root so all iPad views and the DeepLinkRouter can read it.
acceptance_criteria: NavigationModel.swift exists and defines both AppSection and iPadNavigationModel
AppSection has exactly 6 cases matching the existing tabs
iPadNavigationModel is an @Observable class with the five selection properties
iPadNavigationModel is injected into the SwiftUI environment in AggregatorApp.swift
